brief:
Palestinian directors have produced films capturing daily reality amid the conflict, Middle East Eye reported. Hosam Abu Dan's "Thirteen in Gaza" and Ahmed Hassouna's "Citizen Osama" were both filmed during periods of widespread destruction in the territory.

The works represent contrasting Palestinian perspectives on survival and existence in Gaza, offering documentary accounts of conditions on the ground during the ongoing crisis.
